title: Fire department equipment repair and replacement
summary: The fire department reported in 2024 that engine six, which survived the fire, needed hundreds of hours of repairs, and in 2026 it said five new mini trucks face final inspection and the fire shop services over 220 pieces of equipment. The commission is to get a report on large equipment bids next month.
